findings.title: Equinor: Update regarding cyber-attack
findings.summary_md: Equinor's original 17 November 2026 notice said it had detected an ongoing cyberattack against certain IT systems and had mobilised resources to neutralise it and regain full integrity. It said there were no indications data had been stolen and that operations and production were unaffected, with relevant authorities being informed. The page was published at 17:55 UTC on 17 November, ahead of the engine's first_seen timestamp.

findings.title: NRK: Equinor, pågående cyberangrep mot IT-systemer
findings.summary_md: NRK reported on 17 November 2026 that Equinor was working to neutralise the attack and that PST was aware and would assist as needed; NSM was also in dialogue with the company. It noted that the first version of Equinor's press release said employees could experience disruptions to some services and needed no action, but those sentences were later removed. A company spokesperson declined to say which systems were affected.

findings.title: Aftenposten: Equinor har avdekket et pågående dataangrep mot IT-systemer
findings.summary_md: Aftenposten reported on 17 November 2026 that Equinor had detected an ongoing cyberattack against some IT systems, with no data theft indicated and no effect on production. The article said disruptions involved applications and internal IT systems, and gave Equinor's scale: about 25,000 employees, offices in more than 20 countries, 67 percent Norwegian state ownership and a market value of 980 billion kroner. It also reported that NSM, the petroleum safety regulator and several ministries had been notified.

findings.title: Reuters via Euronext: Equinor detects cyberattack against some IT systems
findings.summary_md: Reuters, carried by Euronext on 17 November 2026, reported that Equinor had detected an ongoing cyberattack against certain IT systems and had informed authorities. The company said it was mobilising resources to neutralise the attack and regain full integrity, and reported no data theft or impact on operations. The Euronext page timestamps the item at 18:10 UTC.

findings.title: Reuters via CNA: Norway's Equinor detects ongoing cyberattack, oil and gas output unaffected
findings.summary_md: Reuters, syndicated by CNA on 17 November 2026, reported that Equinor's internal email system was down, citing a company source, and that NTB reported disruptions to IT applications and internal systems. Norway's National Security Authority said it was aware of the incident and noted that it had raised the cyberattack risk assessment to four on a five-level scale the previous month, with successful cyber operations against Norwegian companies having tripled over six months. A company spokesperson declined further detail.
